Hi Soojin / Alicia —

Thanks for the clear summary and the mapping doc — that helps. Quick answers up front: 

1) Entitlement model: For mixed billing models we typically recommend seller-reported metering for usage-metered features (PutUsage) and contract entitlements for seat-based or quota entitlements. The Marketplace allows both, but the reconciliation path differs: metered usage hits Marketplace billing directly; contract entitlements are tied to the subscription purchase and fulfillment record.

2) Fulfillment payload: See the following required fields for SaaS fulfillment: customer account identifier (buyer account id), marketplace order id, fulfillment id, product code, dimension (for metering), and timestamp. We also recommend including your internal invoice number as optional metadata so your AR can match records.

3) Trials: Trials can be represented via a 0-cost entitlement for the trial period; if you plan to auto-convert to paid, you should include a webhook/notification pattern so Marketplace events trigger your provisioning.

I reviewed the XLSX quickly — two asks: (a) can you include a sample PutUsage payload for the top two metered dimensions; (b) can Acme confirm the identifier they will treat as the canonical customer id (AWS account id vs. their internal customer id)?

Let's hop on a 30-min call tomorrow 10/19 at 10:30am PT if that works for everyone. I'll invite the Marketplace Seller Enablement engineer who handles fulfillment testing.

Regards,
Neil Harrison
AWS Marketplace Partner PM
